work.name: Overjet
work.summary: Core Product Engineer and Technical Lead for a 6-engineer Provider Network Management (PNM) squad, driving the end-to-end modernization of both frontend and backend stacks while delivering critical credentialing and payer enrollment workflows.
highlights: Spearheaded the migration to a 'Provider-first' architecture, centralizing data ownership to eliminate sync complexity and unblocking the launch for 3 major payers.
Secured commercial contract with large payer by shipping a production-ready Public API in two weeks, replacing fragile Express routes with a type-safe Hono/Arktype architecture.
Migrated test infrastructure from serial Dockerized Postgres to parallelized Pglite, reducing CI runtime by 60% and cutting local execution from several minutes to sub-minute.
Modernized the frontend by introducing GraphQL for E2E type safety while refactoring tightly-coupled legacy components into a modular, hook-based architecture.
Consolidated fragmented polyglot services into a unified TypeScript monolith, drastically reducing cognitive overhead and maintenance while restoring synchronous data consistency.

work.name: Medallion
work.summary: Developed performant, automation-centric product initiatives as a full-stack engineer utilizing Django, React, and GraphQL at a fast moving health-tech startup.
highlights: Pioneered GraphQL integration, migrating REST endpoints and cultivating an active community to improve dev velocity.
Built a high-throughput provider import pipeline using Celery and Customer.io, decreasing turnaround times by 30%.
Integrated real-time verifications using Celerybeat/Pusher, ensuring compliance while streamlining operations.

work.name: American Express
work.summary: Developed site/infrastructure related features and enhancements as a full stack engineer on Amex's GCS Commercial team using React, Redux, and GraphQL - making a combined impact of several hundred million dollars annually.
highlights: Executed A/B tests, including a mobile carousel enhancement projecting $150M in annual incremental revenue.
Spearheaded site-wide accessibility improvements by cataloging violations and reducing outstanding issues by 95%.
Built an internal Chrome extension to automate auth syncing, improving developer workflow times by 90%.

work.name: Heat.wav
